5.3.13 file : Format filename

The file tag will cause its contents as a filename. It can occur mixed with any text. It is similar to the var (239) tag.

Example:

The file <file>me.exe</file> is searched in the PATH.

will be formatted as:
The file me.exe¡ is searched in the PATH.

See also: b (163), i (188); u (232), var (239)
